error.no_accounts: No account yet. Run `relais init` first.
error.claude_not_found: The claude command was not found in PATH.
error.not_logged_in_default: Claude Code is not signed in. Run `claude auth login`, then `relais init`.
error.login_failed: Sign-in did not complete for {alias}; nothing was registered.
error.invalid_alias: Use lowercase letters, digits, - or _ for an account name.
error.no_better_account: No other account has room left right now.
warn.profile: the profile of {alias} could not be checked ({details}).
warn.sync: shared settings could not be synced ({details}).
init.next: Next: `relais account add <name>` for each other account, then `relais statusline-install` and `relais shell-install`.
add.signin: Sign in with the account for {alias} in the Chrome window that opens…
add.done: Account {alias} ({email}) added. Switch to it with `relais switch {alias}`.
remove.done: Account {alias} removed. Its profile stays in {dir}.
switch.note: Sessions already running keep their account; `relais continue` carries a conversation over.
exec.limited_prompt: {alias} is limited: back in {in} ({time}). Continue this conversation on {best} ({pct} used)? [y/N]
statusline.installed: Status line wrapped: Relais now records usage, and your status line renders as before.
statusline.already: The status line is already wrapped by Relais.
statusline.not_installed: The status line was not wrapped by Relais.
doctor.account_signed_out: {alias}: not signed in (run `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR={dir} claude auth login`)
doctor.conflicts: {alias}: real files where links are expected: {names}
doctor.statusline_off: Status line: not wrapped (run `relais statusline-install` to record usage)
doctor.shell_off: Shell: `claude` does not run through Relais yet (run `relais shell-install`)
help.about: Several Claude accounts on one Mac, working as a relay team. Relais never touches a credential.
help.init: Register the account Claude Code is signed in with (~/.claude) as the first account
help.account.add: Create a profile for another account and sign in through Claude Code
help.account.remove: Stop managing an account (its profile is kept)
help.switch: Make an account active: a name, next, prev or best
help.exec: Run Claude Code with the active account (used by the shell function)
help.run: Run Claude Code with a given account, in this terminal only
help.sync: Sync the shared settings of every account now
help.continue: Resume a conversation with the active account (the latest one without an id)
help.statusline: Record usage from Claude Code's status line input, then render your status line
help.statusline-install: Route Claude Code's status line through Relais
help.shell-init: Print the shell function that makes `claude` run through Relais
help.doctor: Check accounts, profiles, status line and shell setup
shell.installed: `claude` now runs through Relais in new terminals.
shell.uninstalled: `claude` runs on its own again in new terminals.
help.shell-install: Make `claude` run through Relais (adds a line to ~/.zshrc)
error.wrong_account: You signed in as {actual}, not {expected}: nothing was registered. Try again and choose {expected} on the sign-in page.
exec.limited_prompt_unknown: {alias} is limited (return time unknown). Continue this conversation on {best} ({pct} used)? [y/N]
help.account.login: Sign an account in again, in its own profile and Chrome profile
login.signin: Sign in again with the account for {alias} in the Chrome window that opens…
error.relogin_wrong_account: You signed in as {actual}, not {expected}: that sign-in was undone. Try again and choose {expected} on the sign-in page.
help.desktop: Show the account Claude Desktop uses, or switch it: your workspace stays as it is, and new terminals follow
desktop.no_folder: not signed in to Claude Desktop yet: it will ask once
desktop.still_running: Claude Desktop did not close; nothing was moved. Quit it, then try again.
desktop.open_failed: Claude Desktop could not be opened again; open it yourself.
desktop.sign_in: Claude Desktop is open without an account: sign in with {email}. Your workspace is ready for it.
desktop.switched: Claude Desktop is open on {alias}; its sign-in is not confirmed yet.
desktop.signed_in: Claude Desktop is on {alias}, signed in. Your conversations, folders and pins are where you left them.
desktop.other_account: The Claude desktop app opened on another account than {alias}: check it before using it.
help.account.adopt: Keep the account signed in on the default profile: the account recorded there moves to a profile of its own
adopt.done: {alias} ({email}) now holds the default profile. {previous} ({previous_email}) stays registered with a profile of its own: sign it in with `relais account login {previous}`.
error.adopt_not_signed_in: Nothing is signed in on the default profile. Run `claude auth login` first.
error.adopt_unknown_email: Claude Code does not say which account is signed in on the default profile.
error.adopt_nothing_to_do: {alias} already holds the default profile: there is nothing to adopt.
error.adopt_no_default_account: No registered account uses the default profile.
doctor.account_mismatch_default: {alias}: signed in as {actual}, registered as {expected}. To keep {actual} on this profile: `relais account adopt`. To bring {expected} back: `relais account login {alias}`.
help.desktop.dry_run: Say what the switch would do, and change nothing
help.desktop.own: When the account has conversations of its own: add them to your list, or put them aside
desktop.plan: {from} → {to}: {conversations} and their folders, pins and order follow you.
desktop.plan_sign_in.old_folder: {to}'s sign-in comes from its former Desktop folder, kept aside as an archive.
desktop.plan_sign_in.none: {to} is not signed in yet: Claude Desktop will open on its sign-in page, sign in with {email}.
desktop.plan_live: Still working: {conversations}. Closing Claude Desktop stops them.
desktop.plan_own: {to} has {conversations} of its own: --own add keeps them in your list, --own aside puts them aside (recoverable).
desktop.plan_duplicates: {conversations} of {to} already in your list under another name will be put aside, so nothing shows twice.
desktop.need_choice: {to} has {conversations} of its own. Run again with --own add or --own aside.
desktop.inside_app: This runs inside Claude Desktop, which closes during the switch and would stop it halfway. Switch from the Relais panel or from a Terminal; --dry-run works here.
desktop.interrupted: An earlier switch was cut short: it has been undone, and Claude Desktop is back on the account it had.
error.desktop_unknown_account: Claude Desktop is signed in to an account Relais does not know. Add it with `relais account add <email>` first; nothing was moved.
error.desktop_missing_ids: Relais does not know {alias}'s account ids yet: run `relais account login {alias}` first.
error.desktop_conflict: {path} is in the way, so nothing was moved. Look at it before trying again.
desktop.interrupted_pending: An earlier switch was cut short. The next switch, from the Relais panel or a Terminal, undoes it first.
